jobs.title: Program Manager – forensic mental health
jobs.description:
LCSWs, LMFTs, and LPCCs are encouraged to consider a full-time Program Manager position with Liberty Healthcare’s forensic mental health program in San Diego County.

Services and locations

This program exclusively serves justice-involved adults who are experiencing mental illness and have been determined to be incompetent to stand trial.

The goal of this program is to provide rapid mental health services to people in need so they may achieve improved behavioral health outcomes as quickly as possible.

Liberty Healthcare’s services are provided to inmate clients primarily at these jail facilities:

Las Colinas Detention and Reentry Facility in Santee, CA
Rock Mountain and George Bailey Detention Facilities in South San Diego near Otay Mesa, CA

Responsibilities

As Liberty Healthcare’s Program Manager, you will enjoy a mix of leadership and clinical responsibilities, including:

Leading an outcomes-focused forensic mental health delivery system
Ensuring clients receive person-centered care and high-quality mental health services
Supervising, training, and managing clinical and ancillary staff across multiple locations
Promoting a high-performance culture and overseeing quality assurance initiatives
Fostering collaborative relationships with a wide array of stakeholders
Providing direct clinical services to clients

Work schedule

The work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 4:30 pm with availability for occasional after-hours phone consultation.

Approximately 40% of your time will be spent onsite at the Santee location and 60% onsite at the jails located near Otay Mesa.

Salary And Benefits

Starting salary between $125,000 and $140,000 (depending on qualifications)
Health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, and disability insurance
30 days of paid time off each year for holidays, vacation, sick leave, and personal days
FSA, 401k plan, and other perks

Full details on Liberty's benefits plan are available at www.libertyhealthcare.com/upload/143.pdf

Qualifications

Professional licensure in California as a Licensed Clinical Social Worker, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor
Leadership experience
Knowledge of best practices in the treatment of people who are experiencing serious mental illness

Experience in a correctional or forensic mental health setting is preferred.

Liberty Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our organization is composed of, and proudly serves, people of diverse backgrounds and abilities.

If you are interested in leading an impactful mental health program - click “Apply” and submit your resume for immediate consideration.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Claude Corps
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the education sector, focusing on training college computer science students across the United States. It addresses the challenge of bridging the gap between technical talent and workforce demands, particularly in the rapidly evolving AI field. With partnerships including major technology companies and a $150 million initiative to build an AI workforce program, the organization supports a large scale of learners and aims to create significant economic impact.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Program Manager, Claude Corps role is central to managing and executing a national fellowship program that places AI-trained fellows at nonprofits. This position involves overseeing the program plan, coordinating across multiple teams and external partners, and ensuring smooth operations. The role is critical for maintaining momentum and alignment across stakeholders, enabling the program to scale and achieve its strategic goals.

3. Responsibilities:

• Own and maintain the master program plan for all program workstreams.

• Track timelines, milestones, communications, and dependencies.

• Manage daily relationships with external partners to ensure commitments and hand-offs are on track.

• Facilitate planning meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.

• Identify and clear blockers, escalating issues that require higher-level decisions.

• Produce executive-level and team status reports.

• Document and systematize mature workstreams for scalability.

• Design processes and tools that support efficient program operations.

• Develop the operational infrastructure to scale the fellowship program.

4. Requirements:

• Minimum 3 years managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs.

• Ability to evaluate and act on existing plans and assumptions.

• Experience in founding or early-stage teams with broad ownership and autonomy.

• Strong written and visual communication skills tailored to diverse audiences.

• Proficiency using AI tools and project management software.

• Technical fluency to collaborate effectively with program, product, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

• Ability to analyze program data to identify risks and escalate appropriately.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

• $85,000 - $110,000

6. Benefits & Perks:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance with 90% employer coverage for employees and dependents.

• Employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, flexible spending accounts, and employee assistance program.

• 401(k) plan.

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance and identity theft protection.

• Generous paid time off, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and annual year-end closure.

• $1,000 annual professional development stipend.

7. Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note: RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Claude Corps
new_jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the education sector, focusing on training college computer science students across the United States. It addresses the challenge of bridging the gap between technical talent and workforce demands, particularly in the rapidly evolving AI field. With partnerships including major technology companies and a $150 million initiative to build an AI workforce program, the organization supports a large scale of learners and aims to create significant economic impact.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Program Manager, Claude Corps role is central to managing and executing a national fellowship program that places AI-trained fellows at nonprofits. This position involves overseeing the program plan, coordinating across multiple teams and external partners, and ensuring smooth operations. The role is critical for maintaining momentum and alignment across stakeholders, enabling the program to scale and achieve its strategic goals.

3. Responsibilities:

• Own and maintain the master program plan for all program workstreams.

• Track timelines, milestones, communications, and dependencies.

• Manage daily relationships with external partners to ensure commitments and hand-offs are on track.

• Facilitate planning meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.

• Identify and clear blockers, escalating issues that require higher-level decisions.

• Produce executive-level and team status reports.

• Document and systematize mature workstreams for scalability.

• Design processes and tools that support efficient program operations.

• Develop the operational infrastructure to scale the fellowship program.

4. Requirements:

• Minimum 3 years managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs.

• Ability to evaluate and act on existing plans and assumptions.

• Experience in founding or early-stage teams with broad ownership and autonomy.

• Strong written and visual communication skills tailored to diverse audiences.

• Proficiency using AI tools and project management software.

• Technical fluency to collaborate effectively with program, product, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

• Ability to analyze program data to identify risks and escalate appropriately.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

• $85,000 - $110,000

6. Benefits & Perks:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance with 90% employer coverage for employees and dependents.

• Employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, flexible spending accounts, and employee assistance program.

• 401(k) plan.

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance and identity theft protection.

• Generous paid time off, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and annual year-end closure.

• $1,000 annual professional development stipend.

7. Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note: RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.
